deadline.value: No fixed deadline: doctoral posts are advertised at least twice a year, each with its own deadline.
deadline.quote: these doctoral posts are advertised at least twice a year

funding.value: Applicants must have funding arranged; in most cases the department provides it as employment as a doctoral student.
funding.quote: In most cases, the Department of Astronomy provides funding in the form of employment as a doctoral student

entry_route.value: A master's degree in physics/astronomy is required, or a bachelor's plus 60 advanced credits in astronomy including a 15-credit project; a master's is a merit.
entry_route.quote: you must have a Master’s degree in physics/astronomy (or a Bachelor’s degree together with an additional 60 credits of advanced courses in astronomy

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study
